name: voicesense-primus-enrollment
description: Bundles @primuslabs/zktls-js-sdk for the VoiceSense enrollment iframe.

scripts.doctor: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='../app/primus_enroll/frontend/vendor/zktls-bundle.js'; const t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); if(!t.includes('PrimusZKTLS') && !t.includes('Primus')) { console.error('SDK bundle missing Primus exports'); process.exit(1);} console.log('ok', p, t.length); "
